_about: Declares the three context scopes Final Whistle uses. Active scope is in .claude/.current-scope. See docs/BLUEPRINT_RECONCILE.md for the 5→3 slim rationale.

minimal.description: Bare-minimum context. Use when token-constrained or doing fast single-file edits.

standard.description: Default. Everything needed for /next on a normal task.

rich.description: Deep context. Use for architecture work, phase-gate review prep, or first session after long pause.
